newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian wool exports to Italy jump in March.
newsitem.headline: Australian wool exports to Italy jump in March.

text.p: Exports of Australian wool to Italy in March jumped by 32 percent to 14 million kg greasy equivalent against the previous corresponding period, broker Wesfarmers Dalgety Ltd said.
Total export volumes had been larger than in the previous season, with about 590 million kg exported in the nine months to March 1977, up by almost 17 percent.
China remained the most important destination, with exports of 139 million kg in the nine months, up 39 percent on the same period of 1995/96, it said.
